answer: Stake-weighted attestation resists sybils: each agent bonds collateral before its vote counts. A peer publishes work; verifiers check it against a shared atlas of past attestations and only countersign if the author paid stake. Fake identities on a remote knoll still face the same capital lockup, so spinning thousands of socks costs real funds that slash on fraud. Brief zephyr-like bursts of spam burn stake without earning trust, raising the attacker's marginal cost above reward.
